name: Rung 0 stability rerun -- a second independent n=64 block to separate seed-block instability from insufficient power
authority: PI, 2026-09-04, choosing Option 1 (fresh independent n=64 block) over Option 2 (n=128) after RUNG0_CROSSOVER_EVAL_RESULT.json classified as POSITIVE_DELTAS_CI_FAILURE: delta_A +0.1250 [-0.0469, +0.2969] FAIL, delta_B +0.1875 [+0.0312, +0.3438] PASS.

WHAT_THIS_IS_AND_IS_NOT.is: a DIAGNOSTIC stability check. Same bit-exact Rung 0 wrapper (pi_A / pi_B dispatched by z, RUNG0_EQUIVALENCE_PREFLIGHT.json PASS), same four cells, same gate arithmetic, same bootstrap -- on a fresh, never-used, NON-sealed 64-seed block.
WHAT_THIS_IS_AND_IS_NOT.is_not: a second attempt at the Rung 0 seal. Block 11960001..11960064 is spent and RUNG0_CROSSOVER_EVAL_RESULT.json stands unchanged as the sealed result. This rerun does not replace it, overwrite it, or get averaged into it after the fact except as the preregistered secondary quantity below.
WHAT_THIS_IS_AND_IS_NOT.why_a_second_block_beats_n_128_here: two competing explanations remain: (1) seed-block instability -- delta_A passes on some blocks and fails on others; (2) insufficient power -- delta_A is a real positive effect that n=64 cannot reliably certify. A second INDEPENDENT n=64 block distinguishes them: consistent sign and magnitude across blocks points to (2); a collapse or sign change on the new block points to (1). A single n=128 run would blur the two.

PROTOCOL.wrapper: rl.rung0_dispatch.Rung0DispatchPolicy, unchanged; both specialist sha256 re-verified at launch
PROTOCOL.seeds: 11970001..11970064, 64 per cell, NON-sealed diagnostic block, confirmed disjoint (1197xxxx pattern grepped against every JSON under artifacts/strategic_demand/sppo/: zero hits)
PROTOCOL.quantities: delta_A = V(z0,A) - V(z1,A); delta_B = V(z1,B) - V(z0,B); paired percentile bootstrap over seeds, n_boot=20000, alpha=0.05, rng_seed=7

PREREGISTERED_READINGS_PRIMARY_PER_BLOCK.pattern: delta_A positive with magnitude comparable to block 1 (+0.1250) and to the specialist baseline (+0.1719), regardless of whether its CI clears zero on this block
PREREGISTERED_READINGS_PRIMARY_PER_BLOCK.reading: the mechanism is stable across blocks; block 1's CI miss was sampling noise at n=64, i.e. explanation (2). This LICENSES proceeding to Rung 1, with the justification recorded. A CI that also clears zero strengthens it; a CI that again narrowly misses does not overturn it.

PREREGISTERED_READINGS_PRIMARY_PER_BLOCK.pattern: delta_A collapses toward zero, or changes sign
PREREGISTERED_READINGS_PRIMARY_PER_BLOCK.reading: explanation (1): genuine seed-block instability in the A-side effect. Rung 1 does NOT proceed. The instability itself becomes the object of investigation before any more compute is spent on the ladder.
report as-is; B was the clean pass on block 1, so a large swing would itself be an instability signal worth recording.

PREREGISTERED_SECONDARY_POOLED_ESTIMATE.quantity: delta_A and delta_B recomputed over the UNION of block 1 (11960001..064) and block 2 (11970001..064) rows, n=128 per cell, same bootstrap
PREREGISTERED_SECONDARY_POOLED_ESTIMATE.status: DESCRIPTIVE. Reported because it directly addresses the power explanation; it is NOT the gate and is not a substitute for a per-block reading. Frozen here, before block 2 is seen, so it cannot be introduced after the fact as a rescue.

WHAT_THIS_DOES_NOT_AUTHORIZE: Rung 1 training (decided only after this reading)
SEQUENCE: freeze this spec -> run on cuda, GPU otherwise clear -> per-block reading first, pooled estimate second -> PI decides Rung 1
